text:
anya: Quick question — for the Create Pool form, should required fields use the red asterisk only or an explicit "Required" suffix? Screen reader folks said asterisks alone are ambiguous. sam: I'd prefer explicit 'Required' text. asterisk is visual only :thinking_face: liam: Accessibility wins for explicit label. also easier in translations (no ambiguity). maria: Agree. Side note: inline error timing — show on blur, but don't show error while user is actively typing on focus unless it's clearly invalid (e.g., badly formatted email). anya: New concern: inline errors sometimes push layout and move CTAs on smaller screens. Could we reserve the space with a zero-height helper and expand when an error appears? avoids jumps. sam: Reserve space or absolutely position the message under the field both work. need to test density on mobile. liam: For destructive actions: current modal uses just 'Are you sure?'. Security/Compliance wants typed confirmations for large irreversible deletes. Thoughts on thresholds and copy? maria: Typed-confirm for irreversible deletes (e.g., deleting a model + artifacts, or >10GB datasets, or deleting multiple items). For one-off small deletes use clear copy + undo toast. anya: Draft copy: "Permanently delete model \"foobar\". This action cannot be undone. Type the model name to confirm." sam: Love the copy. Implementation notes: use aria-describedby for the confirmation input and set focus trap in modal. For typed-confirm, should we allow paste? Some teams want to disallow to prevent accidental confirmation. liam: Don't block paste. it punishes keyboard users and power users. The friction should be in the intentional act, not anti-patterns. maria: Accessibility nit: when inline error appears, announce via aria-live="polite". For form-level summary (e.g., on submit) use aria-live="assertive" at the top so screen readers jump. Assertive for summary only. anya: Proposed ARIA policy: field-level inline errors => role=status + aria-live=polite; form-level summary => role=alert or aria-live=assertive. Matches WCAG guidance. sam: Quick snippet for field-level error: ```
Please enter a valid email.
``` liam: Also add a visually-hidden 'Required' token for screen readers like `Required` rather than title attr or relying on color. maria: UX edge-case: when we reserve space for errors we should avoid making forms look too sparse. maybe show faint helper text slot (empty) so spacing feels intentional. anya: Decision check: explicit 'Required' label + reserving error space + typed-confirm for destructive over threshold + ARIA live policy (polite for field, assertive for summary) — any objections? sam: +1 liam: +1 anya: I'll file the ticket with copy variants and a small prototype for desktop/mobile behaviors and paste a link here later. thanks! :sparkles: design-bot: New PR created: #2898 — Prototype: forms/error-behavior (assigned to anya)
